purpose: Bind current expectations to Topology 006: eight admitted architectural peer systems, four currently execution-ready peer lanes, four admitted peers blocked on canonical control records, terminal Prose retirement, owner isolation, Programming continuity, and Knowledge Recovery 001 priority.

completion_expectations.requirement: PROSE is historically complete and terminally retired; it has no active work or execution domain.

SYSTEM_MASTER, CORE, LEARNING, BOOK, DOCUMENTS, SPREADSHEET_DATA, MEDIA, CONNECTED_ACTIONS and RESEARCH_KNOWLEDGE remain incomplete regardless of completed packets, tests, phases, ownership registration or subsystem evidence.
A system becomes complete only through explicit product-level completion authority; no chat, branch, workflow, phase, admission decision or ownership registration may infer completion.
PROGRAMMING is an incomplete active work program and is not an admitted peer system until explicit future authority establishes that boundary.

Architectural peer admission and execution readiness are distinct. SPREADSHEET_DATA, MEDIA, CONNECTED_ACTIONS and RESEARCH_KNOWLEDGE are admitted peers but remain non-dispatchable until their required canonical control records and execution authority exist.

job_expectations.requirement: Integrate CORE, LEARNING, BOOK, DOCUMENTS, SPREADSHEET_DATA, MEDIA, CONNECTED_ACTIONS and RESEARCH_KNOWLEDGE without taking their product semantics; never resurrect a retired system.

Finish shared Foundation/Spine and integration primitives only; while Knowledge Recovery 001 is selected, prioritize Programming proving-corpus recovery then authorized catalog/archive recovery as highest discretionary work.
Finish Learning and integrate it upward into System Master without crossing Book, Documents, Programming, or newly admitted peer product semantics or creating active Prose work.
Finish Book; own any genuinely unfinished integration of preserved completed Prose capability as ordinary Book work; retain canonical Book authority; then integrate upward into System Master.
Finish Documents and integrate it upward into System Master for document/artifact mechanics; receive no Prose work.

Remain a Core-administered source/custody/provenance support subprogram and the highest discretionary System Master priority while control 001 remains selected; do not become the Programming product or a peer system.
Continue the existing Programming engineering work program from preserved evidence and prepare explicit System Master admission/integration without silent peer promotion or cross-lane ownership.
Own spreadsheet, math, data-analysis and ledger product semantics over CORE shared data/execution primitives; remain non-dispatchable until canonical control authority is established.
Own image, photo, video, voice, audiobook and media product semantics over CORE shared runtime primitives; remain non-dispatchable until canonical control authority is established.

Own browser, calendar, communications and plugin module policy over CORE shared connector-action runtime; no production or unattended execution authority exists before the required control and Foundation 1.0 boundaries are satisfied.

Own research, knowledge and geospatial retrieval semantics over CORE shared connector/data/evidence runtime; consume BROWSER from CONNECTED_ACTIONS rather than owning browser action authority; remain non-dispatchable until canonical control authority is established.

lane_expectations.requirement: The architectural peer systems are exactly CORE, LEARNING, BOOK, DOCUMENTS, SPREADSHEET_DATA, MEDIA, CONNECTED_ACTIONS and RESEARCH_KNOWLEDGE.

The currently execution-ready peer lanes are exactly CORE, LEARNING, BOOK and DOCUMENTS. SPREADSHEET_DATA, MEDIA, CONNECTED_ACTIONS and RESEARCH_KNOWLEDGE are admitted peers but must not receive unattended execution, mutation claims or telemetry lanes until their readiness blockers are cleared.

Second Shift compares the topology execution-ready peer set with registry owner_files and auto-provisions missing coverage only for an already-declared execution-ready peer when machine-resolvable; it never creates a new system, activates an admitted-not-ready peer, or resurrects a retired one.
PROSE has no standalone, child, inherited, repair, qualification, research, telemetry, successor, or auto-provisioned execution. Historical Prose routes are stale and non-dispatchable.
Documents may provide generic document/artifact services to Book but may not absorb Prose, receive completed-Prose integration work, mutate Book canonical state, or take Programming engineering work.

Second Shift, repair routing, obligations, startup and current-state reconciliation fail closed on job/lane violations, stale owner heads, overlapping mutation claims, false execution readiness, or retired-system resurrection.
Programming remains a named non-peer work program until explicit topology admission. It has no peer Second Shift lane and no peer telemetry ledger before admission.

authority_expectations.requirement: Exact-SHA, source-custody, canonical-writer, A-01, human, author, private, native, external, publication and production boundaries are preserved across every reconciliation.

Changed topology, integration, control-record or execution-readiness bytes require fresh evidence; no historical Prose or peer-system PASS transfers across changed subject, topology, readiness or ownership boundaries.
Canonical control records are required before an admitted peer may enter the execution-ready set. Ownership registration alone grants no unattended execution authority.

carried_forward_expectations: All non-conflicting expectations from EXPECTATION-REGISTRY-005 remain historical/current guidance; this registry controls when there is a conflict about Topology 006 peer admission, execution readiness, Prose lifecycle, priority, program job, work-program scope, lane ownership or auto-provisioning.
change_rule: Changing a system/work-program job, completion standing, retired standing, peer admission, execution readiness, ownership route or cross-lane exception requires explicit user direction and a current successor authority transaction.
